note: Prototype Screen 06 Appearance Detail catalogs (Identification / Livery / Surface Finish). Not STA 2E published hull-marking tables (Core p. 194 covers name/registry only). gameplay: cosmetic | contextual | earned. Earned options require Screen 04 / Official Service History selections. linksTraitSource means the marking visualizes an existing Trait and must not grant a second Trait. Weathering is visual only and does not change Structure or damage state. Each slot (except Honor Insignia, which has five) is padded to four options so Screen 06 always shows a full 2×2 choice grid.

options.name: Visible Registry
options.caption: Clear Starfleet registry lettering on the hull.
options.description: Displays standard, readable registry typography. Contextual recognition: other ships and stations can identify the vessel by registry when circumstances allow. Does not change Systems or Departments.

options.name: Minimal Registry
options.caption: Recessed, low-contrast registry markings.
options.description: Uses subdued registry placement for a cleaner silhouette. Cosmetic only.

options.name: Altered Registry
options.caption: Hard-to-read or deliberately altered identification.
options.description: Registry markings are obscured, incomplete, or altered. Contextual: may invite suspicion during security or inspection encounters. Does not change Systems or Departments.

options.name: Offset Registry
options.caption: Registry lettering shifted toward the bow.
options.description: Registry lettering shifted toward the bow. Prototype cosmetic only. Does not change Systems or Departments.
